start.title: Living Words
start.lead: Every chapter is a little story made of ten words. Read each word, pick the right picture and watch the story come alive.

menu.title: Pick your words
menu.lead: The number tells how many letters are in each word. Every level is open - start where you like.

chapters.lead: Each chapter is a little story with ten words. Finish a chapter to open the next one.
chapters.finalText: You have read every story on this level - all two hundred words.

play.microphoneDisabled: The microphone is off in the settings
play.microphoneUnsupported: This browser cannot listen to speech. You can read out loud and pick a picture.
play.microphonePermission: No access to the microphone. Allow it in the browser or keep playing without it.
play.microphoneError: The microphone did not catch the word. Try again or pick a picture.
play.heardSuccess: I heard "{word}"! Now find the picture.
play.heardMismatch: I heard: "{transcript}". Try again or pick a picture.
play.hintUsed: Read it slowly, part by part: {syllables}
play.choiceInstruction: Now find it in the pictures
play.wrongFirst: Almost! Look at all the letters and try again.
play.wrongAgain: Piece by piece: {syllables}. Now find the picture.
play.skipped: We set that word aside. We will come back to it.

parent.buttonLabel: Open the settings for a grown-up
parent.title: Reader progress
parent.lead: The game checks understanding through picking a picture. The microphone adds fun but is never required. The word counters below are for the current language.
parent.microphoneHelp: Works in a supported browser after access is allowed.
parent.soundHelp: Short success sounds, no background music.
parent.resetConfirm: Erase the chapters and the statistics for both languages? This cannot be undone.
